v62.source: NOAA NOMADS GFS 0.25 degree f000 analysis only

intensity_model.model: frozen v37G spatial structure ensemble used as the v62 intensity head
intensity_model.field_contract: 4x17x17 v23-compatible analysis patch, q/31.75 then clipped to [-4,4]
intensity_model.ensemble_spread: standard deviation across the three frozen spatial experts

pressure_map_coupling.method: v62 forecast pressure-map query plus confidence-weighted local-minimum/anomaly-radius coupling
pressure_map_coupling.minimum_confidence: local minimum contribution decays with route-to-minimum offset; route-point map pressure remains the fallback
pressure_map_coupling.wind_pressure_anchor: observed current wind/pressure; map drives only future changes
pressure_map_coupling.radius_method: learned radius baseline rescaled by trusted local quadrant pressure-anomaly extent; max four-degree footprint

causality.enforcement: every input above was checked against the issue time before use; a later-valid input raises CausalityError and the storm falls back
